subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction plugins receive this public current-session reset capability, and which verified bundled harness owners may receive the underlying raw lifecycle queue?
rationale: The branch adds a public plugin capability that mutates persisted session state, while the safe permanent ownership boundary cannot be inferred from harness id strings or tests alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow API after boundary fixes
options.body: Keep reason-only current-session resets, require owner-verified bundled harness identity, carry the canonical reset key explicitly, and require exact-head lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep reset authority internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and expose an owner-controlled compaction outcome that lets core decide whether to rotate the session.

options.title: Pause the API direction
options.body: Split the observed session-state repair from the plugin contract and revisit the public reset capability in a dedicated owner-reviewed design.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API after boundary fixes
recommendation.body: Keep reason-only current-session resets, require owner-verified bundled harness identity, carry the canonical reset key explicitly, and require exact-head lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily controls gateway session reset authority and persisted session lifecycle behavior.
